title: Model & Route Latency Trendboard with Streaming Mode and Trace Links
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Create a new interactive latency trendboard focused on per-model + per-route breakdowns with first-class support for streaming vs non-streaming request modes. The dashboard should show p50/p95/p99 over time, allow toggling streaming/non-streaming, support request-size buckets and cache-hit overlays, and include one-click links from latency spikes to correlated traces (Jaeger/Tempo) and sample spans. This ticket covers the telemetry schema changes, dashboard queries, trace-linking UX, and rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard named 'Latency Explorer: Model → Route' is available in Console under Observability > Latency
p50, p95, p99 are computed and visualized per-model and per-route with streaming vs non-streaming toggle
Time-series charts show configurable buckets for request token length (0-128,129-512,>512) and an overlay for prefix/KV cache hit rate
Interactive heatmap view shows recent 24h p99 hotspots by model+route with link to top traces
Clicking a chart point opens a filtered trace search (time window + model + route + streaming flag) and preserves trace sampling context
Export CSV for a selected model+route+time-range with p50/p95/p99 and sample counts
Automatic anomaly overlay (z-score based) highlights windows exceeding configured threshold and feeds alerts to existing alerts pipeline
Telemetry producers emit the 'streaming' tag and 'request_token_bucket' dimension; pipeline transforms validate and surface these fields to dashboards
tasks: Schema: Add 'streaming' boolean tag and 'request_token_bucket' dimension to request metrics and trace spans (telemetry team)
SDK/Runtime: Ensure tracing hooks include model, route, streaming flag, request token count, cache_hit boolean on root span
Metrics pipeline: Update metric ingestion rules to compute histograms and summary quantiles (p50/p95/p99) by model+route+streaming
Dashboards: Implement Grafana/Looker dashboard panels for time-series, heatmap, and trace linking
Trace linking: Implement safe short-lived signed URL flow to Jaeger/Tempo with RBAC checks (Console UX team)
QA: Generate synthetic traffic to validate quantile calculations across streaming and non-streaming workloads
Rollout: Feature flag dashboard behind 'latency_trendboard_v1' for gradual enablement and telemetry validation
